ideas.pitch: A localized mobile-web health triage platform supporting regional languages like Tamil to assess symptoms, track local disease outbreaks, and connect rural patients directly to nearby primary health centers.
ideas.title: GramAarogyam: Multilingual Rural Health Triage & Outbreak Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets regional healthcare accessibility with local language support and a live outbreak dashboard, matching real-world impact criteria favored by academic panel judges.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile web app for local fishermen in coastal regions like Kanniyakumari that provides hyper-local marine weather alerts, wave height predictions, and emergency SOS routing via SMS gateways.
ideas.title: CoastalCast: Localized Fishermen Weather & Maritime Safety Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent, region-specific coastal safety problem that instantly connects with local university judges from Tamil Nadu.

ideas.pitch: A logistics and route optimization dashboard for local farmers cooperatives to schedule transport, track cold-storage truck temperatures in real time, and minimize crop spoilage before reaching regional markets.
ideas.title: AgriRoute: Farm-to-Market Cold Chain & Perishable Supply Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emphasizes clear economic impact and measurable reduction in agricultural waste, satisfying judging criteria for real-world applicability.

ideas.pitch: A real-time occupancy and queue-management progressive web app for campus facilities like dining halls and libraries, utilizing Wi-Fi probe requests or quick QR check-ins to display live wait times and load balancing.
ideas.title: CampusQueue: Smart Mess & Facility Crowd-Management System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Highly relatable to the host institution (NICHE) and easy to demonstrate live during the offline finale with actual students scanning QR codes in real time.

ideas.pitch: A computer-vision-powered mobile web tool that lets citizens photograph sorted plastic waste at local collection points, automatically verifies material type, and credits digital loyalty tokens redeemable at local partner shops.
ideas.title: EcoAudit: Municipal Plastic Waste & Recycling Incentive Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines computer vision with civic-tech sustainability, appealing directly to panels looking for scalability and real-world municipal applicability.
